correctness.rationale: For gcd(N,6)=1, symbolic expansion gives the two and only two second-difference divisibilities N|h²(12y²+5h²), N|12h³y. At each p^k, valuations with 4s>=k give t>=ceil(k/2)-s, while 4s<k forces t>s; the remaining first condition is impossible unless p=5,k=4s+1. This exhausts all cases including zero steps. The fourth finite difference 24h^4 proves nonextension on the exceptional branch; vanishing nonlinear binomial coefficients proves extension at every index on the full branch. Counting disjoint valuation strata yields B_p(k) and E_5(k); CRT proves multiplicativity. An exact-integer checker directly tests >375,000 start/step pairs, six other prime powers and constructed 5^5 anomalies. No finite test is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact four-term and five-term progression invariants of a natural polynomial curve are completely determined for every modulus coprime to 6. The result gives sharp, simple squarefree-versus-5-divisibility existence criteria, a complete cycle-extension classification, and an infinite family of nonextendible four-point configurations only at the exceptional five-adic exponent classes. These are natural, structurally motivated boundaries with usable local counts, not an arbitrary finite slice or recomputation of known tables.
